body:
Adds `research/private-data-market` (Waggoner–Frongillo–Abernethy-style market for private data with Gaussian-mechanism privacy).

- Expected payment equals information released, `(λ/2)ln(1+τ/a)`; payments telescope pathwise.
- Closed-form best noise; participation iff `κa<1`, so precision is capped at `λ/(cΔ²)` and approached geometrically.
- Sequential market over-collects from early arrivals (1–22% welfare loss vs planner); ordering effects with heterogeneous data.
- 8 unit tests, experiments, whitepaper, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
